newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: ESR recommends Portugal's Cimpor as buy.
newsitem.headline: ESR recommends Portugal's Cimpor as buy.

text.p: Espirito Santo Research (ESR) said it recommended the purchase of shares in Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal and that the share price had traded at a discount compared with the overall Portuguese market.
"In terms of Price Earnings Ratio, Cimpor has traded with a discount of 17 percent compared to the Portuguese market," ESR said in an analysis, referring to a previous high of 3,925 escudos.
"Our recommendation is still to buy," it added.
ESR forecasts that Cimpor's 1997 net consolidated profit should grow by 17 percent to 23.6 billion escudos in 1996, compared with 1996.
It said it expected a dividend yield of 3.6 percent for both 1996 and 1997, rising to 3.7 percent in 1998.
Cimpor stood at 3,742 escudos, down 106, in volume of 101,279 shares at 1228 GMT.
